question: Describe your experience with financial modelling.
intendedUser: Professional in Track-D with early-career experience
description: Behavioural interview question for Track-D professionals.
exampleAnswer: I built a 3-statement financial model for a new product launch. It included revenue projections, cost structure, and cash flow analysis.
